They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Poe, Edgar Allan, 1809-1849; Manet, Édouard, 1832-1883 [Illustrator]; Mallarmé, Stéphane, 1842-1898 [Translator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: The Raven,  	Philadelphia, Tyndale, c1865, 1865, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/the-raven-1865. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 30%, 92%, 58% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Édouard Manet, Stéphane Mallarmé, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
